refnamediv.refpurpose: Check whether a cache entry exists

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public boolYac::has stringkey
Determines whether an unexpired entry exists for key. Unlike Yac::get, this does not update the entry's access time or hit counter. This method is available as of Yac 3.0.0.
The same non-destructive lookup is used by Yac property syntax as of Yac 3.0.0. isset returns &false; for a missing key or a key storing &null;; empty returns &true; for a missing key or an empty value; and property_exists returns &true; for every unexpired entry, including one storing &null;. These operations do not update the entry's access time or hit counter.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &true; when an unexpired entry exists for key, &false; otherwise. A stored &null; or &false; still counts as an existing entry.
